original: You are within a winding cave passage shrouded in sulfurous mist.  The cave walls are damp with moisture and the echoing sounds of mysterious chanting swirl in and out with the mist.
translation: 你身處一條蜿蜒的洞穴通道中，硫磺瀰漫的濃霧籠罩四周。洞壁因濕氣而濕滑，迴盪的神秘吟唱聲隨著霧氣時隱時現。

original: Before you is an ancient looking man seated before a fire.  He looks up from his meditation to speak, 'Once you have reached Ralith there will be no turning back.  Only a teleport spell will return you to Ymros.  Choose a path wisely.'
translation: 你面前坐著一位年邁的老者，正對著一堆火冥想。他抬起頭，開口說道：「一旦你抵達拉利斯(Ralith)，就再無回頭路。唯有傳送法術能帶你回到伊姆羅斯(Ymros)。慎選你的道路。」
note: 專有名詞依 glossary 音譯統一(硬規則 4)。 專有名詞依 glossary 硬規則 4 保留英文(精訊做法)。
